title: headcount-sync-org-planning-prep-maya
agenda: Quick sync on org priorities + Q2 hiring ask overview (10m)
Interview loop health: open reqs, time-to-offer, candidate pipeline (15m)
Role-level discussions: SWE infra vs SWE runtime (15m)
Budget / approvals / SLA for Dedicated hires (10m)
context_summary: Prep notes for headcount sync. Focus on aligning engineering hiring priorities with product roadmap and Dedicated capacity launches. Quick snapshot of current pipeline and blockers. Use this doc as my talking points and as the post-meeting action list.
current_headcount_snapshot: Average time to hire (req opened -> accepted): 48 days
priority_roles: SWE - Serving Runtime (2 ICs) - critical for Q2 throughput features
SWE - Platform (1 IC) - autoscale + quotas work
SRE / Reliability (1 IC) - Dedicated SLA onboarding
Product Manager - Dedicated (1 FTE) - to own infra-product roadmap
ML Infra / Applied ML infra (1 IC) - quantization/ops
interview_loop_notes: Loop structure: phone screen -> take-home design (optional for SRE) -> onsites (2x 1:1 + 1 system design)
Pain points: long scheduling delays (avg 12 days from screen to onsites), need more interviewer bandwidth
Quality: strongest candidates coming from referrals and targeted outreach (esp. runtime community)
Action: throttle calendar admin delays by blocking 3 dedicated interview slots/week per interviewer for the next 6 weeks
key_blockers: Comp band alignment for senior runtime hires (need approval from finance)
Interview capacity: folks OOO next week (Lena + 2 eng interviewers)
Pipeline dryness for Senior SRE — reach out to recruiting specialist for targeted sourcing
Approval delay on 1 FTE PM for Dedicated (pending leadership FY26 budget sign-off)
decisions_needed: Approve +2 SWE serving runtime headcount and greenlight comp band uplift for Senior+ candidates
Confirm PM hire priority (Product vs Platform) — decide at meeting
Temporary interviewer compensation (referral bonus / hiring blitz incentive) — decide spend cap
talking_points: Tradeoffs: hiring senior runtime now vs junior hires + ramp. Senior gets us to delivery for Dedicated SLA faster but costs more upfront.
Risk: if we miss SLA timeline for Dedicated, sales churn risk increases; recommend prioritizing SRE + 1 runtime senior
Hiring velocity improvements: recruiter + hiring manager weekly syncs, dedicated interview slots, and clearer rejection messaging to speed pipeline
offer_strategy: For Senior runtime: target top of band, quicker closing (48h standard), sign-on where required
For IC levels: standard band + minor flex; emphasize remote + performance upside
Use rolling approvals for immediate critical reqs (temp override process) — need exec OK
proposed_timeline: Week 1 (Mar 2-8): finalize comp bands, recruiter brief, source list
Week 2-3: focus sourcing + screens, schedule batch onsites
By end of Q1: 2 offers accepted for runtime, 1 SRE onboarded
Q2 planning: expect 2-3 ramped engineers contributing to Dedicated features
